predict.question: Every job passes all three stations. In B they handle 6, 5 and 10 jobs/hour. How many completed jobs per hour can B sustain?

exploreHint: Run both cases. Watch which station limits completed jobs per hour.
bookIdea: The E-Myth Revisited distinguishes building repeatable operating systems from relying on the owner to do every job.
modelBoundary: Every job passes all three stations. A completes {A} jobs/hour; B completes {B}. In B, the owner can pass six per hour, but the handoff handles only five. More than five cannot finish. Real delegation outcomes are not estimated.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
